name: print-social-frame-and-framework-typographic-poster-with-yellow-slabs
title: Cream poster with rotated FRAMEWORK on both sides, FRAME and WORK across the edges, and four overlapping translucent yellow slabs
whatItIs: A cream poster in a black frame with heavy black words framing the edges: 'FRAMEWORK' rotated up the left and right sides, 'FRAME' across the top right and 'WORK' across the bottom left, small columns of text beside them and four slightly rotated translucent yellow rectangles stacked in the middle that darken where they overlap.
whatItMeans: Structured and playful; type literally forms the frame while yellow slabs sit inside it.
techniques: Frame the layout with giant words along its edges.
Stack translucent rectangles that overlap to darker tones.

vocabulary.definition: Words forming a border around content.
Translucent shapes darkening where they cross.
